figureObjective: Show before, contact, and after states for momentum transfer between two co-directional cars under negligible external force.

claims.text: During the collision, car m1 loses momentum and slows while car m2 gains momentum and speeds up.
The contact forces and resulting impulses on the two cars are equal in magnitude and opposite in direction.
The two-car system has the same total momentum before and after the collision when friction and other external forces are negligible.
This bounded source example supplies symbolic masses, velocities, momenta, forces, and collision duration but no required numeric values or units.

elements.meaning: Rear car m1, which slows and loses momentum during contact.
Lead car m2, which speeds up and gains momentum during contact.
System boundary containing both cars and excluding negligible friction.

allowedVariation.rule: The three states may be arranged horizontally or vertically if time order, system boundary, and every arrow direction remain unambiguous.
Car silhouettes, colors, and line weights may vary without implying different masses or speeds.

mutations.description: Make m1 speed up and m2 slow down, or draw both contact impulses in the same direction.
